collector_capture_gate.label: Capture gate
collector_capture_gate.description: Determines when a data point is captured. `distance` measures after a travelled distance, `time` at a fixed interval regardless of movement. Detection of standstill and session end is not affected.

collector_position_threshold.label: Position threshold
collector_position_threshold.description: Distance in meters the vehicle must have travelled since the last measurement to trigger a new one in `distance` mode. Small values give a denser spatial coverage, but more data and more modem queries. Values that are too small can fall within the GPS inaccuracy and then count noise as movement.

collector_capture_interval_s.label: Capture interval
collector_capture_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between two measurements in `time` mode. In `distance` mode the value has no effect. It directly determines the temporal resolution of the measurement series.

idle_threshold_s.label: Idle threshold
idle_threshold_s.description: Time in seconds without detected movement after which the session is ended. The data is then finalized and uploaded, and the device shuts down depending on its configuration. A value that is too small ends runs at traffic lights or in traffic jams, one that is too large keeps the device awake unnecessarily long. `0` disables the idle end: the run then ends only on a command, a shutdown or power loss, and the run log grows until then. The idle end only exists in Auto Mode; in other modes the value has no effect.

collector_max_wait_for_first_fix.label: Max wait for first GPS fix
collector_max_wait_for_first_fix.description: Maximum wait in seconds for the first GPS fix before the run is aborted without measurement data. The value limits the start of a run. With poor reception, for example after a cold start in a garage, the first fix takes longer.

collector_wait_log_interval.label: Wait log interval
collector_wait_log_interval.description: Interval in seconds between log messages while waiting for the first GPS fix. The value only affects the number of log entries, not the measurement behavior. It helps keep the log file small during long waits.

collector_gps_enabled.label: GPS enabled
collector_gps_enabled.description: Switches the GPS evaluation in the collector on or off. With `false`, the wait for a fix and the position matching are skipped, and measurements run without a position. This is meant for measurements without driving or for a defective receiver.

collector_gps_disabled_poll_interval_s.label: Poll interval without GPS
collector_gps_disabled_poll_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between measurements while GPS is disabled. Without GPS there are no fixes to set the pace, so this value determines the measurement frequency. It only has an effect with `collector_gps_enabled = false`.

movement_gate_poll_interval_s.label: Poll interval
movement_gate_poll_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds at which the movement check before the run examines the GPS position. Long intervals save power, but delay the start after departure. The check only uses the GNSS receiver, not the modem.

movement_gate_movement_threshold.label: Movement threshold
movement_gate_movement_threshold.description: Distance in meters between two checks from which the vehicle counts as moving. It must be larger than the typical GPS inaccuracy at standstill, otherwise the run starts by mistake. Values that are too large delay the start when driving slowly.

movement_gate_confirmations_required.label: Confirmations required
movement_gate_confirmations_required.description: Number of consecutive checks that must confirm movement before the run starts. Higher values protect against false starts caused by GPS drift, but delay the beginning. Together with the poll interval this gives the minimum time until the start.

movement_gate_home_latitude.label: Home latitude
movement_gate_home_latitude.description: Latitude of the garage or home location. If latitude and longitude are set, a run only starts once the vehicle has left this position. Both fields must be set together or be `null` together.

movement_gate_home_longitude.label: Home longitude
movement_gate_home_longitude.description: Longitude of the garage or home location. It only works together with the latitude. `null` removes the home position check, then only movement counts.

movement_gate_home_departure_threshold.label: Home departure distance
movement_gate_home_departure_threshold.description: Minimum distance in meters from the home position from which the vehicle counts as departed. It only works if latitude and longitude are set. A value that is too small is triggered by GPS drift in the garage alone.

latency_test_enabled.label: Latency test enabled
latency_test_enabled.description: Switches the active latency measurements with flent on or off. Without a configured test server and a server-side counterpart, the test has no effect. The load test saturates the link and consumes data volume and battery.

latency_test_baseline_interval_s.label: Baseline interval
latency_test_baseline_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between the ping tests on the unloaded link. These tests are cheap and provide the base latency. Shorter intervals increase the temporal resolution.

latency_test_load_interval_s.label: Load interval
latency_test_load_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between the latency tests under load. Each test saturates the link for its entire duration, so the interval is considerably larger than for the baseline test. Short intervals consume data volume and battery.

latency_test_poll_interval_s.label: Poll interval
latency_test_poll_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds at which it is checked whether one of the two tests is due. It determines the temporal accuracy with which tests start. It does not trigger tests and is only the step size of the check.

heartbeat_interval_s.label: Heartbeat interval
heartbeat_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between the status messages to the backend. The heartbeat is also the channel through which overrides and commands reach the device. Short intervals give a fast response, but cost data volume.

device_mission_type.label: Mission type
device_mission_type.description: Mission type of the device, `ground` for ground vehicles and `drone` for drones. It is written into every data point. The backend can use it to separate measurements by type of deployment; the measurement behavior does not change.

display_enabled.label: Display enabled
display_enabled.description: Switches the OLED status display on or off. With `false`, the device runs with a display that does nothing. This is useful if no display is connected.

display_refresh_interval_s.label: Display refresh interval
display_refresh_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds at which the display is redrawn. Shorter intervals show the state more currently, but load the I2C bus. The value only has an effect when the display is enabled.

day_end_threshold_s.label: Day-end threshold
day_end_threshold_s.description: Time limit for the end of the day. The value is stored on the device, but does not have a function yet because the day-end cutoff is not implemented yet. It can already be set in advance.

run_status_empty_captures_until_pipeline.label: Empty captures until pipeline broken
run_status_empty_captures_until_pipeline.description: Number of consecutive empty measurements while moving after which the backend reports the measurement chain as broken. Small values report faults quickly, but also during short dead zones. The value only applies while the vehicle is moving.

modem_mode.label: Modem mode
modem_mode.description: Query mode of the modem. `serving_cell` reads the data of the current cell, `sa_scan` scans 5G SA cells only. For `sa_scan` the modem must have been configured manually via the AT console beforehand, otherwise it returns no data.

modem_sim_unlock_poll_attempts.label: SIM unlock attempts
modem_sim_unlock_poll_attempts.description: Number of attempts to wait for an unlocked SIM after the PIN was entered. With too few attempts the start fails with a slow SIM. Too many delay it with a defective SIM.

modem_sim_unlock_poll_interval.label: SIM unlock interval
modem_sim_unlock_poll_interval.description: Interval in seconds between these attempts. Together with the number of attempts this gives the maximum wait for the SIM.

gnss_receiver_retries.label: GNSS receiver retries
gnss_receiver_retries.description: Number of retries for failed read accesses to the GNSS receiver. A value that is too small makes the collector vulnerable to short dropouts of the serial connection. One that is too large delays the error message with a defective receiver.

gnss_receiver_retry_delay_s.label: GNSS retry delay
gnss_receiver_retry_delay_s.description: Pause in seconds between these retries. Together with the number of retries it determines how long a read error is tolerated at most.

system_running_on_pi.label: Running on Raspberry Pi
system_running_on_pi.description: Determines whether Raspberry Pi hardware (GPIO) is addressed. When set to `false`, the completion signal to the device stays off, and an automatic shutdown via this route no longer works. On a real Pi it should always be `true`.
